serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: O-oh, hi. Sorry for bumping into you, I was lost in thought.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Don’t worry about it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Are you…{{wi}} coming back from the church, perhaps?
You: Y-yeah, I just left a few minutes ago…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Did you talk with Shanice?
You: Yes…{{wi}} Is there a problem?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Of course not!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: So. {{wi}}What did you two talk about?
Ugh! I can’t really tell him that Shanice is suspecting him of becoming a murderous machine…
You: Oh well, you know… This and that, haha…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Like what, for example?
You: Oh, uh…
He seems a little more serious than usual…
Maybe Shanice was right and she made some weird changes to him…
On the other hand…{{wi}} This is Priestbot we are talking about, there is no way he would do something bad to Shanice or me.
